deviation.description: Highlights differences from a reference point

examples.description: Russia crude discount flipping to premium — green bar left, red bar right of center parity line
Winners vs losers — RIL/ONGC green bars right, OMCs red bars left. Chart.js horizontal bar with positive/negative coloring
OMC earnings sensitivity tornado — HPCL -62%, BPCL -51%, IOCL -55% red bars left vs RIL +45%, ONGC +40% green bars right. Pure CSS two-sided horizontal bar
Pre-crisis vs crisis GRM slope chart — SVG connecting lines between left (baseline) and right (crisis) columns. Green lines up for RIL, red lines down for OMCs

correlation.description: Shows relationship between two or more variables

examples.description: NCI vs GRM bubble scatter — bubble size = capacity, color = profit/loss tier. Chart.js bubble chart in light panel

ranking.description: Compares items in an ordered list

examples.description: Hormuz dependency by product — horizontal bar chart with color-coded severity thresholds
China 11, India 3, Japan 0 — KPI strip comparing countries by transit count, color-coded by success
Refinery NCI ranking lollipop — dots on horizontal lines from 0 to 25 scale. JS-generated, color-coded by owner type (green=RIL, amber=OMC, red=laggard)

change_over_time.description: Shows how values evolve across a time period

examples.description: Futures curve with strategic annotation callout (LOCK $69-75). Chart.js line with annotation plugin
Declining line crossing insolvency threshold — dashed zero line with INSOLVENCY annotation
Pulsing dots with phase colors (amber early, red late), staggered fade-in animation on scroll
2x2 mini sparkline grid — Brent, Indian basket, USD/INR, GRM. SVG inline sparklines with area fill, current value + delta badge per cell
Mine clearance Gantt timeline — ceasefire to flow restoration with milestone diamonds, color-coded phases, dependency arrows. Pure CSS grid layout

magnitude.description: Emphasizes size or scale of a single value

examples.description: DAY 20 big number with radial gradient background, pulsing countdown label, stat row with 3 KPIs
74 days reserve cover with release-vs-hoard tradeoff panels side by side
Import bill decomposition waterfall — step-by-step value build-up from baseline to total with connector lines
SPR days-of-cover vertical towers — India 9.5d vs USA 32d vs Japan 90d vs China 90d. Height-proportional bars with IEA 90-day dashed threshold line
SVG semi-circular gauge for reserve depletion — color gradient arc, needle, milestone cards

part_to_whole.description: Shows how individual parts make up a total

examples.description: 42% crude, 90% LPG — horizontal bars showing percentage of whole, plus falling dominoes with severity labels
22 ships as dots — 3 green (through), 19 red (stranded) — with legend and cargo KPI breakdown
10x10 waffle grid (100 squares) — 42 red squares for Hormuz dependency, 58 gray. Big number callout, detail stats, JS-generated grid
SVG donut chart showing percentage dependency with side legend and callout box
Three risk zones with numbered circles on Leaflet map — Hormuz, Gulf targets, Bab al-Mandab
Shipping map with colored dots by country, pulsing chokepoint marker, dashed transit route
Clean Gulf region map — 3 numbered markers (Hormuz, Ras Tanura, Fujairah), CartoDB light tiles, structured legend below with risk details. No overlap

Simple Sankey flow — 4 source nodes through hub to destination with gradient bands
Three probability scenarios with gradient backgrounds (amber/red/green), inline stat chips, and insight text
Verdict banners (gradient header) with data proof panels — compare rows, destroyed grids, voyage bars
Two opposing quotes side by side with colored left borders — Trump vs Araghchi format
Numbered action items with deadline KPIs (pulsing countdown) and amber/red urgency indicators
Large background symbol/number, section title in red uppercase, subtitle — act break between sections
Deadline rows with mono date and description, closing summary line, radial gradient background
Banks say X vs Reality Y — verdict banner panels with contrasting consensus vs truth format
Big pulsing countdown number with three-outcome decision tree (HIGH/MED/LOW scenario cards)
Dark KPI panels with colored left borders, JetBrains Mono values, muted sub-labels — 2x2 and 3-col layouts
RAG status card — 5 supply chain items with glowing red/amber/green circle indicators, grid layout with status level, detail text, and summary strip
Before vs after horizontal strip — 3 metrics (Urals discount, import bill, rupee) with arrow connectors, delta badges, and context labels
